feasts.name: Feast of Breaking the Fast
feasts.text: Bonfires on the hills of {realm} greet the high sun above {town}.

feasts.name: Feast of the Pilgrim Caravan
feasts.text: Granaries of {realm} are opened at {town}; the whole town eats until dusk.

feasts.name: Night of Lanterns
feasts.text: Scholars and singers of {realm} compete in {town}; the best verse is carried through the streets.

festivals: Lanterns and sweets fill the souks of {town} as {realm} breaks the long fast together.
cultures.music: oud, reed pipes and call-and-response verse
cultures.architecture: courtyard houses, minarets and covered souks

cultures.name: Tsynopa
cultures.food: black bread, borscht, pickles, kvass and honey
cultures.dress: embroidered linen shirts, sheepskin coats and headscarves

feasts.name: Burning of Winter
feasts.text: People of {realm} wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at {town}.

feasts.name: Night of Wreaths
feasts.text: Bonfires on the hills of {realm} greet the high sun above {town}.

feasts.name: Feast of the Ancestors
feasts.text: Families in {realm} set out lamps and food for their dead at {town}.

festivals: Wreaths float down the river at {town} on midsummer night; young folk of {realm} leap the fires.

events.text: The annalists of Lersuf will remember the years 60 to 80 as "The Decline of Lersuf".
The annalists of Hoty will remember the years 60 to 80 as "The Burning Years of Hoty".
The annalists of Datsazhi will remember the years 60 to 80 as "The Golden Years of Datsazhi".
The annalists of Bitsabia will remember the years 60 to 80 as "The Restless Years of Bitsabia".
The annalists of Saydan will remember the years 60 to 80 as "The Quiet Years of Saydan".
The annalists of Vujvimmir will remember the years 60 to 80 as "The Restless Years of Vujvimmir".
The annalists of Tuytuiz will remember the years 60 to 80 as "The Ascendancy of Tuytuiz".
The annalists of Kahuniri will remember the years 60 to 80 as "The Restless Years of Kahuniri".
The annalists of Mematika will remember the years 63 to 80 as "The Golden Years of Mematika".
The annalists of Nytsa will remember the years 69 to 80 as "The Golden Years of Nytsa".
Garrison at Rohadongi repels a cross-planet invasion pouring through the Silent Rift!
A victor's peace is forged: after 4 years of campaign in the Border War of Lyyghyeh, Wemanui prevail, annexing contested borderlands.
Humbled, Megacorp of Lyyghyeh bends the knee and becomes a vassal of Wemanui, paying yearly tribute.
ENFORCED REGIME CHANGE: Victorious armies from Wemanui mandate total political reorganization in Lyyghyeh! Overthrowing the vanquished elite, they inaugurate the Stratocracy of Lyyghyeh.
Êthâ of Qaqmiut takes up the cause of the safety of the corp-state.
In the royal halls of Qaqmiut, Êfâ the Timid Ifmânmân breathes their last, succumbing to a hunting accident. Êthâ ascends the ancestral boardroom amid solemn acclamation.
Êth II of Tissim takes up the cause of the spread of the faith.
Mourning envelops Tissim: Êth the Wise Kâkmâth dies of battle wounds. The royal scepter passes to Êth, an underage youth of 10 years, under the stewardship of high chancellors.
Fêth of Vujvimmir takes up the cause of knowledge.
In the royal halls of Vujvimmir, Thith the Bold Mikim breathes their last, succumbing to fever. Fêth ascends the ancestral boardroom amid solemn acclamation.
Kimo of Fepinui takes up the cause of the fortunes of the dynasty.
Dynastic extinction strikes Fepinui: Nguhapoka dies heirless (poison). Amid whispers of poison and sword-drawn councils, House Mefireke claims the vacant board.
Stock in Mematika goes vertical: new arcologies rise and the upper tiers party for a year.
A catastrophic fire tears through the wooden quarters of Wavanui, consuming whole avenues and reducing venerable storehouses to smoldering ash.
Êfâ (Archmage) summons an aura of calm that cleanses local sickness in Tangjut.
COVERT INTRIGUE: Agitators dispatched by Lersuf stir mutiny among garrison troops in Ngoruwepeha!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Lersuf are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Ngoruwepeha!
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Warovene pave the Ngatavika-Wewowiva Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Ngatavika and Wewowiva (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Te Lari pave the Tilihu-Mihuta Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Tilihu and Mihuta (+trade, +stability).
The Lujgaj–Turviq Maglev of Tissim reaches Mitnamngaq: a new station opens to cheering crowds (+trade).
The Kangomotu–Wewowiva Maglev of Warovene reaches Ngatavika: a new station opens to cheering crowds (+trade).

ELDRITCH MANIFESTATION: Nyxal the Void Dreamer projects psychic void-whispers into the foes of Sugaki! Invaders flee in weeping delirium, haunted by visions of tentacled cosmic voids (+18% army power, -7 stability).
Gig-workers of Tobebe go dark and jam every delivery drone in protest at Sofeba’s cut.
Unrest of the year: bread riots in Glikhlentum (Clana).
A notorious bandit encampment, Mupawu Outlaw Lair, arose outside Mupawu.
Jebsa'ha Corsair Haven raided trade routes near Jebsa'ha, siphoning 147 gold into their hoard.
Tiromiwi Corsair Haven raided trade routes near Tiromiwi, siphoning 44 gold into their hoard.

Le'akiloth Outlaw Lair raided trade routes near Le'akiloth, siphoning 56 gold into their hoard.

Zi'oqtyeha of Lyyghyeh comes to the boardroom bent on the safety of the corp-state.
Choziva conquered Floor 1 (Floor of the Emerald Canopy) using assault (score 32 vs DC 8). Defeated Oryx. Promoted to F-Rank!
Rukihawi survived descent to Layer 1 (Edge of the Abyss), enduring 14 strain damage: Light dizziness and loss of balance upon ascent. Whistle tier: red. Salvaged ancient relic: Sun Stone Shard!

DIVINE PROXY WAR: The war between Hongeha and U'iklyyt escalates into a celestial proxy duel! Solarius the Dawn-Bringer rallies the hosts of Hongeha, while Nyxal the Void Dreamer unleashes sacred omens to shield U'iklyyt.
NATURE BLESSING: Gorath the Stone Peak heaves rich subterranean veins to the surface of Sewchaw! Granite ramparts harden against all siegecraft (+25 gold, +15 stability).
NATURE BLESSING: Gorath the Stone Peak heaves rich subterranean veins to the surface of Dupobu! Granite ramparts harden against all siegecraft (+25 gold, +15 stability).

The Congregation of the Root Kernel spreads through Tunototekugu’s darknet, preaching that uploading the soul is the only salvation.
Unrest of the year: tax riots in Vujvimmir.

monsters.name: The Celestial Raptor
monsters.lore: A colossal winged terror of celestial heights whose wingspan eclipses the noon sun and commands cyclones.

monsters.name: Winterfang
monsters.lore: A frost-breathing great wyrm dwelling in glacial crevasses, freezing rivers solid with a single exhalation.

monsters.name: Abyssal Terror
monsters.lore: A colossal multi-tentacled sea monster capable of pulling entire armadas down into the black abyss.

monsters.name: Ignis the Red Calamity
monsters.lore: An ancient volcanic dragon sleeping atop mountains of melted gold, reducing invading armies to calcined bones.

monsters.name: The Auspicious Horned Beast
monsters.lore: A gentle horned dragon-beast cloaked in scales of jade, appearing only during the reigns of benevolent and enlightened rulers.

monsters.name: Tusk-Lord of the Briars
monsters.lore: A massive armored tusker leading wild forest herds, tearing up farmland and trampling watchtowers.
monsters.trophy: Calydonian Boar Great Tusks & Armored Hide

monsters.name: Lion of the Golden Dawn
monsters.lore: An immortal noble lion with a mane of radiant sunlight, whose majestic roar dispels dark enchantments.
monsters.trophy: Solar Lion Mane of Golden Light

monsters.name: The Primeval Behemoth
monsters.lore: A colossal terrestrial colossus whose bones are tubes of bronze and limbs like bars of iron, roaming ancient grasslands.

monsters.name: The All-Knowing Simurgh
monsters.lore: A vast and wise bird that has seen the world destroyed three times; it may help a hero or test them.

monsters.name: The White Cadejo
monsters.lore: Spectral dogs of the night roads: the white one guards travellers, the black one leads them astray.

monsters.name: Smokeless-Fire Ifrit
monsters.lore: A spirit of smokeless fire, proud and cunning, bound by old seals and older bargains.

monsters.name: Hand-Tailed Ahuizotl
monsters.lore: A water dog with a hand at the end of its tail that drags fishermen beneath the lake.

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.

diseases.name: plague
diseases.desc: carried by fleas on rats and on the cloth of traders; it rides the roads and the ships

diseases.name: flux
diseases.desc: drunk from fouled wells and river water; it follows the rivers downstream and haunts the ports

diseases.name: pox
diseases.desc: passed hand to hand and breath to breath; those who live through it never take it again

diseases.name: marsh fever
symptoms: a yellow cast to the skin
diseases.desc: brought by biting flies in hot wetlands; it lingers where the water stands still

diseases.name: consumption
symptoms: a cough that brings up blood
diseases.desc: a slow sickness of crowded cities that eats the lungs over years

diseases.name: blight
diseases.desc: a rot of the crops, not of people: it kills by hunger

diseases.name: miasma
symptoms: a lead taste in the mouth
diseases.desc: the bad air of the factory towns, thickest where the chimneys stand closest

diseases.name: radiation sickness
diseases.desc: not caught but soaked up: it clings to fallout grounds and the dust of old craters

diseases.name: engineered strain
diseases.desc: something made in a vat or a lab that got out; it spreads fast and burns out fast

diseases.name: hollowing
symptoms: a cold that no fire warms
diseases.desc: a sickness of the spirit; the old wives say it comes from broken wards

feasts.text: The longest night in {realm} is spent by firelight in {town}, with stories and gifts.

feasts.name: Ballgame of the Hero Twins
feasts.text: Warriors of {realm} parade and wrestle in the squares of {town} to honour the old victories.

feasts.name: Day of Rain Offerings
feasts.text: People of {realm} wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at {town}.

festivals: Astronomers of {town} predict the eclipse to the day; {realm} celebrates the turning of a great cycle.
cultures.architecture: limestone temple-pyramids, observatories and carved stelae

events.text: Artificers and scholars achieve a historic breakthrough: Orbital Elevator (Vacuum Maglev Hyperloop, Single-Stage Aerospike Shuttle) spreads between guilds and academies across the realms!
Mihpe (Master Artisan) unveils a breathtaking marble colossus in the central plaza in Tleco.
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Ghuzxugg are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Bu-meze!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Clandestine agents from Plonze sow suspicion in the frontier councils of Ntonko.
COVERT INTRIGUE: Shadow agents from Psisvu divert 25 gold from the tax vaults of Ix-nasuta!
QUEST COMPLETED: Raid on the Shadow Keep in Putoki! Zvochka successfully frees the captive, escorting them to safety and earning 100 Gold in grateful tribute!
QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Vupo embarks upon the Voyage of the Late Dhow to Bedapupo! Vupo hears that the dhow fair at Bedapupo will close before the cargo arrives.
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Putoki pave the Putoki-Napunemotu Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Putoki and Napunemotu (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of U-dome pave the Mupo-Thegorod Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Mupo and Thegorod (+trade, +stability).
The Ki-nya–Ntonko Maglev opens: the first maglev of Ntonko runs from Ki-nya to Ntonko, with stations in both towns.
The Satupuha–Josotenal Maglev of Nopulik'in reaches Sinomu: a new station opens to cheering crowds (+trade).
Glitched shrines blink on Epetun billboards: the Ghost Protocol worships an AI that, they say, woke up.
The Congregation of the Root Kernel spreads through Smice’s darknet, preaching that uploading the soul is the only salvation.

Wirewenga of Ngukinui lets go of the aim for a lasting legacy.
Dekhage conquered Floor 1 (Floor of the Radiant Mirage) using magic (score 19 vs DC 8). Defeated Vaelis. Promoted to F-Rank!
Hizleqa survived descent to Layer 1 (Edge of the Abyss), enduring 10 strain damage: Light dizziness and loss of balance upon ascent. Whistle tier: red. Salvaged ancient relic: Sun Stone Shard!
Contract soldiers of Ki-donide Systems cross into U-dome; Lewo follows its masters into a corporate war.

Citing a hostile takeover of Mupo Securities by Ki-donide Systems, the heralds of Divine Realm of Lewo deliver an ultimatum of war to Military Junta of U-dome. The Conquest of U-dome begins. Pledging mutual defense, the levies of Myeland rally to U-dome's side.
Delvers of Ntice break into a forgotten dwarven gallery; the deep realm grows.
Something vast stirs in the lightless depths beneath Shapuhezamin; the deep wardens double their watch.
After 82 years of vassalage, High Realm of KloRus is formally annexed by Psisvu.
Hexghih throws off the yoke of Ginzenben and declares its independence.
The tiny Corporate Protectorate of Muppok seeks shelter and is peacefully absorbed into Bufalia.
The tiny Tu'i Dominion of Putoki seeks shelter and is peacefully absorbed into Ngukinui.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Frinke bars the shaft to Migabe, and the data-tithe-collectors of Migabe are turned back at the lamps of Hezzulyeh.
Kanuhupampa squeezes the shaft-tolls of Hengun; the miners of Henyin mutter beneath the stone.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Wungunshima bars the shaft to Snysk, and the data-tithe-collectors of VriRus are turned back at the lamps of Henyin.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Dongun bars the shaft to Dregorod, and the data-tithe-collectors of Kanuhupampa are turned back at the lamps of Henyin.
SKY BLOCKADE: the floating hosts of Relewanenara close the air-lanes above Tiñuhala, starving Kanuhupampa of the high trade.
Kaqtay of Ghuzxugg comes to the boardroom bent on the spread of the faith.
In the royal halls of Ghuzxugg, Xaqzeq the Conqueror Qerquh breathes their last, succumbing to old age. Kaqtay ascends the ancestral boardroom amid solemn acclamation.
Pecha of Ix-nasuta takes up the cause of the spread of the faith.
A perilous interregnum grips Ix-nasuta following the heirless death of Cheje (old age). Retainers of House Jokopa storm the assembly and usurp the board.

POPULAR UPRISING: Folk moots and agrarian communes in Balemu seize local protein vats and cast off the yoke of Nehmohtitlan! The people inaugurate the Free Union of Balemu under the stewardship of Beka'e.
Beka'e is acclaimed ruler of Free Union of Balemu.
Outraged by treason, the board of Empire of Nehmohtitlan mobilizes imperial cohorts to crush the upstart insurrection in Free Union of Balemu. The Nehmohtitlan–Balemu War begins in fire and iron.

Galled by heavy data-tithes and distant decrees, the citizens of Tachumnal cast out their corp enforcers! Renouncing all allegiance to Ix-nasuta, Bojesi proclaims the sovereign Cybernetic Union of Tachumnal.
Bojesi is acclaimed ruler of Cybernetic Union of Tachumnal.

Outraged by treason, the board of Merchant League of Ix-nasuta mobilizes imperial cohorts to crush the upstart insurrection in Cybernetic Union of Tachumnal. The Great Ix-nasuta War begins in fire and iron.
The vat farms of Kolxiqtoh catch a blight-code; nutrient prices triple overnight.
Xuhgheh opens the royal protein vats of Kolxiqtoh; bread is carted to every village and the people bless the board.

The Gaki Campaign is known as the Vindication among the Popugoko, and as the Aggression among the Gukhi.
Tisebọ overruns the defensive holdfasts of Ndanpo, annexing the town and its fertile environs from Nkenko.
Garrisons of Tisebọ storm the ramparts of Myunfa, driving out the defenders of Nkenko and hoisting their triumphant colors.
Flames engulf the towers of Mwenkiwa! Soldiers of Tisebọ force the inner courtyards of Nkenko's capital; the royal garrison breaks, and the seat of power falls.
Night of Opening Eyes: Families in Lerqoktet set out lamps and food for their dead at Yahkuhyeh.
A victor's peace is forged: after 2 years of campaign in the Tisebọ–Nkenko War, Tisebọ prevail, annexing contested borderlands.
Humbled, Workers' Federation of Nkenko bends the knee and becomes a vassal of Tisebọ, paying yearly tribute.
ENFORCED REGIME CHANGE: Following decisive defeat in war, Tisebọ imposes constitutional terms upon Nkenko! The former rulers are ousted, and the Kingdom of Nkenko is inaugurated.
Insurrection flares in Mwenkiwa! Declaring their liberties inviolable, the populace casts off the yoke of Tisebọ and rallies beneath the banner of Mbindensa, establishing the High Realm of Ki-mpa.
Mbindensa is acclaimed ruler of High Realm of Ki-mpa.
Seeking to restore imperial order by force, Empire of Tisebọ dispatches punitive legions to subdue High Realm of Ki-mpa. The bitter Tisebọ–Ki-mpa War is underway.
Stock in Tsefla goes vertical: new arcologies rise and the upper tiers party for a year.
Kopi (Philosopher) drafts a universal legal code that enhances provincial stability in Fopikengo.
Yanmin (Archmage) summons an aura of calm that cleanses local sickness in Yunkan.
COVERT INTRIGUE: Counterfeit letters planted by Nkenko rupture trust between Ix-nasuta and their ally Migabe!
QUEST COMPLETED: Rescue of the Royal Heir in Tungi! Nohehpoh successfully frees the captive, escorting them to safety and earning 100 Gold in grateful tribute!
QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Labo embarks upon the Return of the Stolen Mask of Chohtlan! Labo hears that a carved masquerade mask was stolen from a compound at Chohtlan.
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Wowahctitlan pave the Panokab-Huhyeh Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Panokab and Huhyeh (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Henyin pave the Hengun-Lighrey Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Hengun and Lighrey (+trade, +stability).
NATURE BLESSING: Undina of the Silver Basin purifies the sacred rivers of Lewo! Abundant fish and unhindered river trade enrich the townships (+30 gold, +12 stability).
The Ghost Protocol spreads through Mawenui’s darknet, preaching that uploading the soul is the only salvation.
The Congregation of the Root Kernel spreads through Luqqer’s darknet, preaching that uploading the soul is the only salvation.

Whispers in the fields of Myeland: a league of the landless gathers the corp dependants against corporate fiefs.

A royal wedding joins Lewa of Ix-nasuta and Bajaka of Sopopemume; the two realms are united under one board.

SEA EMBARGO: Bufalia seals the deep channels, and no hull leaves the port of Hakimarca for Kanuhupampa.
Fire glows in the throat of Lehnohsih Crater; lava creeps down one flank and the people of Tletlotlih move their flocks.
A twisting storm drops from a green sky onto Nulatapampa, tearing a mile-long scar through houses and barns.
Rains swell the Jelatu until it takes the bridges of Josotenal; whole villages float away downstream.

monsters.name: Qilin of the Cloud-Peaks
monsters.lore: A gentle horned dragon-beast cloaked in scales of jade, appearing only during the reigns of benevolent and enlightened rulers.

monsters.name: Roc the Sky-Render
monsters.lore: The roc of sailors' and caravaneers' tall tales, a bird vast enough to carry off an elephant; its wingbeats raise dust storms over the canyons.

monsters.name: The Radiant Sovereign
monsters.lore: An immortal noble lion with a mane of radiant sunlight, whose majestic roar dispels dark enchantments.
monsters.trophy: Solar Lion Mane of Golden Light

monsters.name: The Sky-Blotter
monsters.lore: A colossal winged terror of celestial heights whose wingspan eclipses the noon sun and commands cyclones.

monsters.name: Winterfang
monsters.lore: A frost-breathing great wyrm dwelling in glacial crevasses, freezing rivers solid with a single exhalation.

monsters.name: The Great Calydonian Boar
monsters.lore: A massive armored tusker leading wild forest herds, tearing up farmland and trampling watchtowers.
monsters.trophy: Calydonian Boar Great Tusks & Armored Hide

monsters.name: Ignis the Red Calamity
monsters.lore: An ancient volcanic dragon sleeping atop mountains of melted gold, reducing invading armies to calcined bones.

monsters.name: Titan of the Steppes
monsters.lore: A colossal terrestrial colossus whose bones are tubes of bronze and limbs like bars of iron, roaming ancient grasslands.

monsters.name: The White Cadejo
monsters.lore: Spectral dogs of the night roads: the white one guards travellers, the black one leads them astray.

monsters.name: Amaru the Winged Serpent
monsters.lore: A two-headed winged serpent of the high lakes, bringer of storms and of the underworld’s waters.

monsters.name: The River-Blocker
monsters.lore: A huge river creature of the deep forest that blocks the flow of rivers with its body.

monsters.name: The Ahuizotl of the Lake
monsters.lore: A water dog with a hand at the end of its tail that drags fishermen beneath the lake.

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.

diseases.name: plague
diseases.desc: carried by fleas on rats and on the cloth of traders; it rides the roads and the ships

diseases.name: flux
diseases.desc: drunk from fouled wells and river water; it follows the rivers downstream and haunts the ports

diseases.name: pox
diseases.desc: passed hand to hand and breath to breath; those who live through it never take it again

diseases.name: marsh fever
symptoms: a yellow cast to the skin
diseases.desc: brought by biting flies in hot wetlands; it lingers where the water stands still

diseases.name: consumption
symptoms: a cough that brings up blood
diseases.desc: a slow sickness of crowded cities that eats the lungs over years

diseases.name: blight
diseases.desc: a rot of the crops, not of people: it kills by hunger

diseases.name: miasma
symptoms: a lead taste in the mouth
diseases.desc: the bad air of the factory towns, thickest where the chimneys stand closest

diseases.name: radiation sickness
diseases.desc: not caught but soaked up: it clings to fallout grounds and the dust of old craters

diseases.name: engineered strain
diseases.desc: something made in a vat or a lab that got out; it spreads fast and burns out fast

diseases.name: hollowing
symptoms: a cold that no fire warms
diseases.desc: a sickness of the spirit; the old wives say it comes from broken wards

festivals: Drums sound from {town} as {realm} gathers for the first fruits of the harvest.
cultures.music: drums, thumb pianos and layered chorus
cultures.architecture: round thatched houses and stone-walled enclosures

cultures.name: Rasiqu
cultures.food: bread, olive oil, wine, cheese and garum
cultures.dress: draped tunics and togas, military cloaks and brooches

feasts.name: Saturnalia
feasts.text: The longest night in {realm} is spent by firelight in {town}, with stories and gifts.

feasts.name: Games of the Arena
feasts.text: Warriors of {realm} parade and wrestle in the squares of {town} to honour the old victories.

feasts.name: Feast of the Vine
feasts.text: Granaries of {realm} are opened at {town}; the whole town eats until dusk.

festivals: Games fill the arena of {town}; {realm} feasts for a week in honour of its founding.
cultures.architecture: forums, aqueducts, arches and domed temples

cultures.name: Bybfyrgir
cultures.food: black bread, borscht, pickles, kvass and honey
cultures.dress: embroidered linen shirts, sheepskin coats and headscarves

feasts.name: Burning of Winter
feasts.text: People of {realm} wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at {town}.

feasts.name: Night of Wreaths
feasts.text: Bonfires on the hills of {realm} greet the high sun above {town}.

feasts.name: Feast of the Ancestors
feasts.text: Families in {realm} set out lamps and food for their dead at {town}.

festivals: Wreaths float down the river at {town} on midsummer night; young folk of {realm} leap the fires.
cultures.architecture: log houses with carved eaves, wooden fortresses and onion-roofed halls

events.text: COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Pawyar! Kuchmil seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Grand Duchy of Pawyar!
COUP D'ETAT: Armed regiments loyal to Sega storm the government palace in Qafupolis! The faction seizes control, establishing the Empire of Qafupolis.
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Rugana! Mose seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Theocracy of Rugana!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Viropura are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Boshusdesh!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Clandestine agents from Berabupuliri sow suspicion in the frontier councils of Legaga.
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Berabupuliri are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Legaga!

NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Kevsinska pave the Kohdodov-Fanfiq Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Kohdodov and Fanfiq (+trade, +stability).

ELDRITCH MANIFESTATION: Nyxal the Void Dreamer projects psychic void-whispers into the foes of Khiudu! Invaders flee in weeping delirium, haunted by visions of tentacled cosmic voids (+18% army power, -7 stability).
The Congregation of the Root Kernel spreads through Vola’s darknet, preaching that uploading the soul is the only salvation.
Kua, a burned-out netrunner, livestreams from Cuezhou that the corps can be logged out of existence; millions tune in.
Glitched shrines blink on Tiragarh billboards: the Ghost Protocol worships an AI that, they say, woke up.
Street samurai Yakenute defends a Yunaka clinic from corp extraction teams; the gangs call a truce in their honour.

Kuchmil of Pawyar comes to the boardroom bent on glory.
Sega of Qafupolis comes to the boardroom bent on the spread of the faith.
Mose of Rugana comes to the boardroom bent on a lasting legacy.
Lire of Mikoguo tires of the chase for gold.
Sitsnaklyh of FirfihRus keeps the corp-state whole through 20 hard years.
Ndumna conquered Floor 1 (Floor of the Frozen Ridge) using tactic (score 11 vs DC 8). Defeated Thalor. Promoted to F-Rank!
Sulriwsisa survived descent to Layer 1 (Edge of the Abyss), enduring 14 strain damage: Light dizziness and loss of balance upon ascent. Whistle tier: red.
Zaa holds the great examinations; a peasant’s son from Zeiling tops the scholars’ list.
A House of Wisdom opens in Kaga; translators of Qasr Humu gather the knowledge of every land.
Mose of Rugana abolishes corporate fiefs: the corp dependants go free and the corp-state adopts free contractors.
Yika of Vitavarta abolishes corporate fiefs: the corp dependants go free and the corp-state adopts free contractors.
A cave-in thunders through Fevekuhe; Ra-vuhu digs for survivors for weeks.
The tiny United Provinces of Yunaka seeks shelter and is peacefully absorbed into Legaga.
Qasr Humu squeezes the shaft-tolls of Vanelara; the miners of Fiwi mutter beneath the stone.
Kesage squeezes the shaft-tolls of Niwuma; the miners of Fiwi mutter beneath the stone.
SKY BLOCKADE: the floating hosts of Tisebọ Beyond close the air-lanes above Siqpuwpata, starving Pawyar of the high trade.
SKY BLOCKADE: the floating hosts of Berabupuliri close the air-lanes above Sadu, starving Kametide of the high trade.
SPORE-RAIN: A rain of glittering spores falls across Riuxia; the harvest is strange but heavy.
A great quake (magnitude 9.4) runs the length of the Mbunnu Fault; Sadu and its neighbours are left in rubble and the roads of Kametide are broken.
The protein vats of Kametide cannot make good what was lost; famine stalks the villages around Sadu.
In the hungry year Vemi spends the treasury of Kametide on grain from abroad; few starve, and they remember who fed them.
LOCUSTS: A cloud of locusts darkens the sky over Kesage; in three days the fields around Tologachu are stripped bare.
Tisebọ Beyond sends an expedition through the Silent Door.
Lantern Festival: People of Zucoqu wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Zucoqu.
U-mponfu overruns the defensive holdfasts of Niriyya, annexing the town and its fertile environs from Qasr Humu.
The banners of U-mponfu are raised over Mitudima as victorious cohorts march in, ending Qasr Humu's dominion over the district.
Following fierce fighting along the fortifications, Sazuqu surrenders to U-mponfu; its magistrates swear fealty as Qasr Humu's banner is hauled down.
Following fierce fighting along the fortifications, Frifro surrenders to Slonti; its magistrates swear fealty as Funsazz's banner is hauled down.
Saturnalia: The longest night in Rugana is spent by firelight in Fukhulo, with stories and gifts.
Envoys from U-mponfu and Vugvassuvriq Beyond exchange solemn vows of mutual defense, binding their courts in a grand alliance.
Denouncing ancient covenants, the heralds of Military Junta of Viropura proclaim war upon Patriarchate of Boshusdesh. Trumpets sound across the frontier as the Great Viropura War begins.
Envoys convene upon neutral ground to ratify a solemn treaty, concluding the War of U-mponfu after 3 years. With frontiers redrawn, U-mponfu dictate terms to the vanquished.
Humbled, Merchant League of Vanika bends the knee and becomes a vassal of U-mponfu, paying yearly tribute.
Sefkikkala of Kevsinska takes up the cause of the safety of the corp-state.
In Kevsinska, Qeo the Wary Khiikhierua departs this life, succumbing to old age. The child Sefkikkala (age 10) is crowned beneath a wary council of regents.

AGRARIAN REVOLT: Crushed by feudal data-tithes and noble exploitation, the laborers of Tekhigomefo rise in open insurrection! Renouncing the lords of Kesage, they establish the Free Union of Taqicarori with Tiqia leading the commune.
Tiqia is acclaimed ruler of Free Union of Taqicarori.
A blazing crimson comet arcs across the night skies above Rirnyhgrad; court astrologers dispute whether it foretells glorious conquest or catastrophic ruin.

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.

diseases.name: plague
diseases.desc: carried by fleas on rats and on the cloth of traders; it rides the roads and the ships

diseases.name: flux
diseases.desc: drunk from fouled wells and river water; it follows the rivers downstream and haunts the ports

diseases.name: pox
diseases.desc: passed hand to hand and breath to breath; those who live through it never take it again

diseases.name: marsh fever
symptoms: a yellow cast to the skin
diseases.desc: brought by biting flies in hot wetlands; it lingers where the water stands still

diseases.name: consumption
symptoms: a cough that brings up blood
diseases.desc: a slow sickness of crowded cities that eats the lungs over years

diseases.name: blight
diseases.desc: a rot of the crops, not of people: it kills by hunger

diseases.name: miasma
symptoms: a lead taste in the mouth
diseases.desc: the bad air of the factory towns, thickest where the chimneys stand closest

diseases.name: radiation sickness
diseases.desc: not caught but soaked up: it clings to fallout grounds and the dust of old craters

diseases.name: engineered strain
diseases.desc: something made in a vat or a lab that got out; it spreads fast and burns out fast

diseases.name: hollowing
symptoms: a cold that no fire warms
diseases.desc: a sickness of the spirit; the old wives say it comes from broken wards
